sites.name: Colossus 2

This estimate is backed up by our cooling and turbine based power production calculations. The cooling calculations suggest there is enough infrastructure to support ~850MW of IT Power. Similarly the energy production c
sites.note: 估計至少830 MW GPU伺服器運算能力，新一階段擴展包括22萬顆GB300處理器及超過400 MW運算能力。

sites.name: Colossus 1
sites.note_en: No major changes to the data center since February. Solar panels have been placed next to the facility.
sites.note: 自2月以來無重大變化，設施旁已安裝太陽能板。

sites.name: Meta Gallatin
sites.note_en: Building 1 is operational, based on a lack of construction activity around the shell and cooling equipment, and about 6 months passing after structural completion.
sites.note: Building 1已運營，結構完成後約6個月，周圍無施工活動。

sites.name: OpenAI Stargate Shackelford
sites.note_en: Buildings 1-5 shells complete and fully roofed. Buildings 1-3 appear to be actively installing cooling and backup generators nearby. The pads for Buildings 6-10 to the north have also been visibly cleared, with foundations for Buildings 6 and 7 underway.
sites.note: Buildings 1-5外殼完成並全部封頂，1-3號樓正安裝冷卻及備用發電機，6-10號樓地基已清理，6、7號樓基礎施工中。

sites.name: OpenAI Stargate Milam
sites.note_en: Steel framing and roofing is underway for Building 1.
sites.note: Building 1鋼結構框架及屋頂施工進行中。

sites.name: Goodnight
sites.note_en: Progress is made on all buildings, Building 1 and 2 specically have begun to install cooling structures. The substation expansion seems to be nearing completion.
sites.note: 全棟樓施工進展中，1、2號樓已開始安裝冷卻設施，變電站擴建接近完成。

sites.name: Crusoe Abilene Expansion
sites.note_en: Land clearing continues.
sites.note: 土地清理施工進行中。

sites.name: OpenAI Stargate Abilene
sites.note_en: Buildings 7-8 are estimated to be operational. On March 24, Building 8 roughly looked like where Building 3 was in September. Building 3 is estimated to be operational in April, 7 months later. This naively suggests Building 8 will be operational by early November, 7 months after March 24. Oracle gave no date for the last two buildings on its September 10 call.
sites.note: Buildings 7-8估計已運營，Building 3預計4月運營，Building 8預計11月初運營。

sites.name: Coreweave Helios
sites.note_en: Building 1 operational at full capacity. This is based on "Phase I", which is [expected](https://investor.galaxy.com/news/news-details/2025/Galaxy-Announces-Third-Quarter-2025-Financial-Results/default.aspx) to be operational by the end of the first half of 2026. We added two months of overhead to account for remaining construction and/or installation of CoreWeave's chips, since the June 17 image still showed active minor construction around the building.
sites.note: Building 1已滿負荷運營，Phase I預計2026年上半年底前運營。

sites.name: Anthropic Barber Lake
sites.note_en: Building 1 shell is complete, with rooftop units installed, and most air-cooled chillers in place in a ground yard to the north. Most of the 120 backup diesel generators are also in place. Substantial progress since Nov 2025, still under construction and not yet energized.
sites.note: Building 1外殼完成，屋頂單元已安裝，大部分120台柴油備用發電機已就位，自2025年11月進展顯著，仍施工中未通電。

sites.name: Google Red Oak
sites.note_en: Building 1 appears active - the surrounding land is finished including the site entrance and the parking lot. The dry coolers for Building 2 are nearly complete although the building is still clearly a construction zone. The Building 2 substation also appears complete.
sites.note: Building 1運營中，周邊土地完成包括入口及停車場，Building 2乾冷卻器接近完成，Building 2變電站完成。

sites.name: CoreWeave Denton TX
sites.note_en: Building 8 interior fit-out scheduled to begin. [TDLR project TABS2026028247](https://www.tdlr.texas.gov/TABS/Projects/TABS2026028247) schedules a $110M interior fit-out of the existing 27,678.22 sq ft Building A as a data hall beginning September 1, 2026.
sites.note: Building 8內部裝修定於開始，27,678.22平方英尺Building A資料中心內部裝修預計2026年9月1日開始。

sites.name: Meta Temple
sites.note_en: Building 3 is operational. Based on the stated completion date in this [regulatory filing](https://www.tdlr.texas.gov/TABS/Search/Project/TABS2026008019)
sites.note: Building 3已運營，依據監管文件規定完成日期。

sites.name: Vantage TX1
sites.note_en: Building 1 operational; Roads around Building 1 complete, all cooling and side generator equipment construction has since finished as well. Although this is still earlier than the completion date reported on TDLR, based on the appearance, we believe it is operational. Reported IT power of 32 MW. [Source](https://www.tdlr.texas.gov/TABS/Search/Project/TABS2024007561)
sites.note: Building 1已運營，周邊道路完成，冷卻及發電機設備施工已完成，IT運算能力32 MW。

sites.name: Google Midlothian
sites.note_en: Estimated full completion of the expanded row of cooling towers and backup generators for Building 1.
sites.note: Building 1冷卻塔及備用發電機擴建行估計完全完成。

sites.name: Microsoft SAT40
sites.note_en: Site has already been completed, with no more visible construction on any building.
sites.note: 施工已完成，所有建築物均無可見施工跡象。

sites.name: Microsoft SAT14
sites.note_en: Building 2 fully operational, Building 1 expanded. Construction is already visibly complete. Additionally, construction phases [Phase 2](https://www.tdlr.texas.gov/TABS/Search/Project/TABS2021019471), [Phase 3](https://www.tdlr.texas.gov/TABS/Search/Project/TABS2021019588), and [Phase 4](https://www.tdlr.texas.gov/TABS/Search/Project/TABS2021019686) on TDLR that collectively represent the completion of the site have a completion date of 2026-03-31.
sites.note: Building 2 全面運營，Building 1 已擴建，施工完成。第2-4期預計2026年3月31日完成。

sites.name: Google Fort Wayne
sites.note_en: Building 2 has all cooling towers installed and is likely undergoing fit-out and commissioning. So we give it about 3 more months until it's operational. Building 3 appears to be slightly further than Building 2 was in March, so we estimate a 4-month lag.
sites.note: Building 2 冷卻塔已安裝，進行調試，預計3個月內運營。Building 3 進度領先，估計4個月滯後。

sites.name: Anthropic-Amazon New Carlisle
sites.note_en: Buildings 17-18 are operational. This is an estimate based on a rule of thumb of "operational 5 months after roof is complete", assuming the roofs took one more month after 2025-12-23. Also added four more months to account for commissioning and adjacent cooling units not being complete yet.
sites.note: Buildings 17-18 運營中。基於屋頂完成後5個月運營的估計，另加4個月用於調試。

sites.name: Meta Jeffersonville
sites.note_en: Building 1 and 2 are operational.
sites.note: Building 1 和 2 運營中。

sites.name: Microsoft Fairwater Atlanta
sites.note_en: Building 3 and 4 are operational.
sites.note: Building 3 和 4 運營中。

sites.name: CoreWeave Dalton 1 & 2
sites.note_en: Building 1 is operational, given it was announced completed 4 months ago and looks completed in satellite imagery. All cooling/mechanical rows are installed, with no obvious active building construction visible.
sites.note: Building 1 運營中，4個月前宣布完成，衛星影像確認完成。所有冷卻/機械排已安裝。

sites.name: xAI QTS Atlanta
sites.note_en: No significant change to the building since the August 2025 image.
sites.note: 自2025年8月影像以來無重大變化。

sites.name: Google Pryor (North)

sites.note: Building 2 運營中，9月8日無人機確認冷卻塔風扇轉動。

sites.name: CoreWeave Muskogee OK

We can assume Building 1 is not operational from all the yard work directly surrounding it, and the lack of a parking lot. Building 2 (The one not leased to CoreWeave) is still in land clearing phase.
sites.note: Building 1 施工完成，周邊土地已清理用於變電站/發電機。Building 2 仍在土地清理階段。

sites.name: Meta Prometheus
sites.note_en: Buildings 7-10 (tents) are operational, based on infrared drone video from RAAD (raad.com) captured on this date. The video suggests that 138.8 MW of nameplate turbine capacity is operating at the Socrates South power plant (about 69% of the 200 MW nameplate capacity), and Buildings 7-10 roof vents are bright on infrared while Buildings 11-12 vents are not. That's 4/6 buildings operating, implying about 67% of capacity, which is consistent with 69% of the power plant operating. In the north, Buildings 16-27 (tents) look to be in a completed state. Each northern set of 6 tents still awaits to b
sites.note: Buildings 7-10 運營中，紅外無人機確認，138.8 MW 發電容量運行。

sites.name: Meta Bowling Green
sites.note_en: Roofs of Buildings 1 and 2 are more than halfway complete. All chillers for both buildings are visible. Construction on Buildings 3 and 4 has begun, with outlines laid. Construction on the [Apollo Power Generation Project](https://archive.ph/lqgZw) (a BTM power plant built just to the east of the data center) is in progress, with foundations poured and generation equipment being set in place.
sites.note: Building 1、2屋頂完成超過一半，兩棟冷卻機組已安裝。Building 3、4已開始施工並完成放樣。Apollo Power Gen

sites.name: Google Columbus
sites.note_en: Confirmation that Building 4 is complete. Building 5 has progressed since February, with a complete roof, all backup generators in place, and five cooling towers in place.
sites.note: Building 4 完成。Building 5 屋頂完成，備用發電機就位，5座冷卻塔已安裝。

sites.name: OpenAI Stargate Lordstown
sites.note_en: Active construction visible on and around the datacenter, with the roofing mostly in place. This is based on satellite imagery. No buildings operational yet.
sites.note: 資料中心及周邊施工進行中，屋頂大部分完成。暫無建築物運營。

sites.name: AWS New Albany
sites.note_en: Satellite imagery shows Building 1 in the northern campus still appears structurally finished, with no visible change from the prior two months, but we're still not counting it operational due to visible construction work around the perimeter. Buildings 2-3 still have nearby generators/cooling equipment being installed, and Building 4 is only roughly 80% roofed. Eastern campus Buildings 5-9 remain operational. Middle campus Buildings 10, 12, 13, and 14 remain operational; Building 11 is still installing backup generators and is not counted.
sites.note: Building 1 結構完成，周邊施工進行中。Buildings 2-3 發電機/冷卻設備安裝中。Building 4 屋頂80%完成。

sites.name: Google New Albany
sites.note_en: Building 5 has all cooling towers installed, and all other components look complete, but there is still light work around the building. Based on that, we estimate 3 more months until operational.
sites.note: Building 5冷卻塔已全部安裝，其他組件看似完成，但建築周邊仍有輕工程，預計3個月後運營。

sites.name: Google Lancaster
sites.note_en: At this point, Building 1 and 2 have since already been operational. Additionally, there is visible steam showing clear evidence of operational for both before this date.
sites.note: Building 1和2已運營，兩棟建築冒蒸汽清楚證明運營狀態。

sites.name: Microsoft Fairwater Wisconsin
sites.note_en: The main shell of Building 2 looks almost completed. In Area 2 (northwest of Buildings 1-2), the grading for the original design has been replaced with grading for the new [9-building design](https://www.mtpleasantwi.gov/AgendaCenter/ViewFile/Agenda/_01212026-1292), making way for Buildings 3-11. Work continues on the northern substation in Area 2.
sites.note: Building 2主體殼層近乎完成。Area 2進行9棟建築新設計基礎工程，Building 3-11施工中，北變電站持續施工。

sites.name: OpenAI Stargate Wisconsin
sites.note_en: Construction continues, Buildings 1 and 2 appear roughly halfway roofed, and building 3 foundation is halfway done.
sites.note: Building 1和2屋頂施工約半完成，Building 3地基施工半完成。

sites.name: Anthropic Lake Mariner
sites.note_en: Building 2 (AKA CB4) is operational. On February 26, Terawulf [stated](https://investors.terawulf.com/news-events/press-releases/detail/132/terawulf-reports-fourth-quarter-and-full-year-2025-results) that CB4 was expected to be energized by Q3 2026.
sites.note: Building 2已運營，預計Q3 2026年前通電。

sites.name: Core42 Lake Mariner
sites.note_en: Both buildings still operational according to satellite imagery.
sites.note: 兩棟建築根據衛星影像仍在運營。

sites.name: Google Mesa
sites.note_en: Building 2 is operational. This is estimated based on the close-to-complete construction status from May 2026.
sites.note: Building 2運營，基於2026年5月近完成施工狀態估計。

sites.name: Microsoft Goodyear
sites.note_en: Foundations appear to be underway for Building 5 and 6, just north of Building 4.
sites.note: Building 5和6地基施工進行中，位於Building 4北方。

sites.name: Stream Phoenix
sites.note_en: Estimated: AI building 1 should be operational. Major construction work finished by January 31, 2026, and the shell looked complete by that date. We estimate after three months the building will be operational.
sites.note: AI Building 1預計運營，主要施工2026年1月31日完成，預計3個月後運營。

Buildings 4-6 shells appear complete, and Building 7 is nearly 90% roofed. This is based on high-resolution satellite imagery from this date.
sites.note: Building 1-3外部完成，冷卻機組已安裝，周邊清理完畢，調試中；Building 4-6殼層完成，Building 7屋頂近90%完

sites.name: Google Cedar Rapids
sites.note_en: Building 1's generators are still only about halfway in place, and ~1/2 the cooling towers are still under construction. Building 2 roofing has been completed, and visible foundations have been built for cooling towers and generators.
sites.note: Building 1發電機約半安裝，冷卻塔約半施工；Building 2屋頂完成，冷卻塔和發電機基礎已建。

sites.name: Google Council Bluffs (East)
sites.note_en: Building 3 is operational. 7 cooling towers were finally installed despite being more spread out compared to the first two buildings. Cooling towers models vary slightly between buildings. Ground clearing to the southwest seems to be setting up for two more buildings.
sites.note: Building 3運營，7座冷卻塔已安裝，西南地面清理為2棟新建築做準備。

sites.name: Microsoft Project Osmium
sites.note_en: No notable changes since October.
sites.note: 自10月以來無重大變化。

sites.name: QTS Richmond 3

sites.note: Building 2和3運營。

sites.note: 所有建築已開始施工，AI Building 6地基施工中。

sites.name: QTS Richmond 1
sites.note_en: No changes to the site since December 2025.
sites.note: 自2025年12月以來，該基地未有任何變化。

sites.name: Google Arcola
sites.note_en: Building 1 is operational, based off of colored motion artifacts from cooling towers and direct visual verification.
sites.note: 1號樓已投入運營，根據冷卻塔彩色運動偽影和直接視覺驗證。

sites.name: Meta Rosemount
sites.note_en: Buildings 1 and 2 are estimated to be operational.
sites.note: 1號和2號樓預計已投入運營。

sites.name: Amazon Ridgeland

sites.name: Amazon Madison Mega Site

sites.note: 6、7號樓屋頂完成；8號樓屋頂接近完成；9號樓屋頂完成一半；無新增投運樓宇。

sites.name: Google Kansas City East
sites.note_en: Building 1 operational. Estimated based on present construction progress and typical timelines.
sites.note: 1號樓已投入運營，基於現有施工進度和典型時間表估計。

sites.name: Google Omaha

sites.note: 3號樓已投入運營（估計），截至5月15日施工工作最少。

sites.name: Google Lincoln

Electrical equipment on the side of Building 2 is also around halfway complete.

sites.name: Meta Sarpy
sites.note_en: Building 1 is operational (estimate).
sites.note: 1號樓已投入運營（估計）。

sites.name: Google The Dalles
sites.note_en: Building 2 is estimated to be operational, based on all external equipment being installed, and ordinary cars parked by the building.
sites.note: 2號樓預計已投入運營，所有外部設備已安裝，普通車輛停放在樓邊。

sites.note: 估計第2棟建築已投入運營，基於施工最後階段後120天、屋頂和冷卻完成後9個月的時間推算。

sites.name: Meta Kuna

sites.note: 第1、2棟建築已投入運營。第二階段太陽能陣列將於2026年5月31日上線，預計數據中心負載將持續增長至8月達最大容量。

sites.name: Meta Cheyenne

sites.note: 估計兩棟建築均已投入運營。

sites.name: QTS Eagle Mountain

sites.note: 第1棟屋頂完成。衛星影像顯示第1、2棟冷卻系統安裝持續進行，應急發電機安裝也在進行中。

sites.name: Meta Eagle Mountain
sites.note_en: Satellite image shows strong evidence that Buildings 1 and 2 are operational: colored motion artifacts on many cooling fans, plus cars parked at the building entrances.
sites.note: 衛星影像顯示第1、2棟建築已投入運營：冷卻風扇有明顯運動跡象，建築入口停有車輛。

sites.name: Meta Aiken
sites.note_en: Building 2 is operational assuming a 3 month lag compared to Building 1.
sites.note: 假設與第1棟相比滯後3個月，估計第2棟已投入運營。

sites.name: OpenAI Stargate New Mexico

A large solar array and water storage basins are visible on site, and two cleared areas on the western side of the campus, likely for on-site power generation. No buildings appear operational yet (no completed roofs or signs of active cooling), consistent with the projected 2028 completion.
sites.note: 自2026年2月以來施工進展顯著，多個建築地基已平整，主數據中心建築結構施工進行中。太陽能陣列和蓄水池可見，預計2028年完成。

sites.name: Meta Los Lunas

sites.name: CoreWeave Ellendale ND
sites.note_en: According to satellite imagery, Building 2 is fully roofed and shell complete, with rooftop chillers mostly installed. Building 3 construction is well underway, with about 1/4 of the roofing done and the foundation laid out.
sites.note: 第2棟已完全封頂，屋頂冷卻機組大部分已安裝。第3棟施工進展順利，約1/4屋頂完成。

sites.name: CoreWeave Lancaster Greenfield site
sites.note_en: Cooling install continues on the roof, satellite imagery indicates that not all units have been completed. Continued presence of construction vehicles and unfinished land on the campus suggests that the building is not operational yet.
sites.note: 屋頂冷卻系統安裝持續進行，衛星影像顯示部分機組未完成，建築尚未投入運營。

sites.name: AWS Berwick
sites.note_en: Building 3 expected to come online sometime around August 2026, since in the May satellite image it appeared structurally complete with minimal construction surrounding it. Basing MW estimate using Building 2 as a reference.
sites.note: 第3棟預計2026年8月左右上線，5月衛星影像顯示結構基本完成。

sites.name: CoreWeave Marble NC

TX.policy: 新州長面臨民眾反對資料中心壓力，議會推動廢除資料中心銷售稅豁免，電網運營商要求資料中心在緊急時降低用電。
TX.impact: 若州政府實施稅收政策調整或用電管制，偏向延長項目審批時程；電網容量限制可能影響擴建進度。

WI.policy: 威州政府與地方城市對資料中心專案採取審慎態度，包括暫停與駁回許可，並將檢視資料中心的環境成本。
WI.impact: 若地方城市持續暫停或駁回許可，偏向延遲Microsoft與Oracle資料中心的建設進度與完工時程。

NM.impact: 若州內出現反對資料中心的組織動員，可能促使州政府重新評估相關許可或環境審查程序

links.title: New Mexico State University students and organizers call for statewide ban on data centers

IN.policy: NIPSCO向印第安納州客戶提供資料中心開發帶來的帳單抵免，反映州政府支持資料中心發展的政策導向。
IN.impact: 若NIPSCO帳單抵免政策順利實施，偏向於降低資料中心營運成本，可能加速Google、Amazon、Meta等項目的建設進度。

links.title: NIPSCO to provide Indiana customers with bill credit from data center development

LA.policy: 路易斯安那州公用事業委員會對資料中心快速審批程序面臨法律挑戰，消費者倡導團體與環保組織質疑審批透明度與承諾履行。
LA.impact: 若法律訴訟延長審批程序，偏向推遲Meta Hyperion的建設進度；若監管機構加強審查，可能影響工程時程。

OH.policy: 民主黨州長當選人Amy Acton上台，州眾議院民主黨人敦促州長在消費者電費上漲前處理資料中心電力成本問題。
OH.impact: 若新州長優先控制資料中心電力成本，偏向可能延緩現有擴建計畫或增加營運成本，影響Meta、Google、Amazon、SoftBank的完工時程。

MI.policy: 州長當選人 Jocelyn Benson 提議對資料中心的水資源、能源使用及稅收優惠制定新規範。
MI.impact: 若新規範對水資源與能源使用設限，偏向延長 Oracle 資料中心的建設與營運許可審核時程。

links.title: Michigan data centers: Governor-elect Jocelyn Benson proposes new regulations on water, energy, tax breaks

TN.policy: 孟菲斯市資料中心禁建投票未通過，暗示州政府對AI資料中心建設持開放態度。
TN.impact: 若禁建投票失敗反映州政府支持態度，則有利於SpaceXAI與Meta資料中心如期推進。

NE.policy: 州長候選人強調 AI 和資料中心不會導致失業，暗示支持產業發展。
NE.impact: 若州政府維持親資料中心立場，偏向加速 Google 和 Meta 項目建設進度。

VA.policy: 州議會議員考慮資料中心暫停令，民主黨2027年議程將資料中心列為目標，環保聯盟施壓推動建設暫停。
VA.impact: 若暫停令通過，將延遲多個資料中心擴建時程；若僅為議程項目，短期影響有限。

OK.policy: 俄克拉荷馬州多個城市延長資料中心開發暫停令，反映對電力與風險的審慎態度。
OK.impact: 若暫停令擴及州級或影響電力供應，CoreWeave Muskogee 2027年12月完工目標面臨延遲風險；Google Pryor 已近完成較不受影響。

GA.policy: 民主黨控制的公用事業委員會計畫加強對Georgia Power資料中心天然氣擴張的監管，並關注電費與停電問題。
GA.impact: 若公用事業委員會加強審查，偏向延長Microsoft、CoreWeave、SpaceXAI等項目的許可與電力配置時程。

points.zh: 民主黨控制新國會後，多位民主黨議員呼籲全國數據中心暫停令，惟參議院相關法案目前無共同提案人。共和黨參議員霍利首次支持暫停令，顯示兩黨內部分歧，暗示新國會對數據中
聯邦能源監管委員會推動電網運營商加速數據中心連接，與國會暫停令呼聲形成張力。新民主黨國會偏向強化環境與公眾參與審查，但許可加速政策仍在進行中，反映行政與立法機構
民主黨控制國會後，紐約州長引用聯邦層級民主黨優勢推動AI監管與聯邦資金支持。新國會偏向加強AI產業監督與環保規範，但與現有許可加速政策存在競張，州法與聯邦協調方
